description: Find Luckin Coffee stores and products, preview orders, and manage orders through the official MCP service.

auth.label: MCP Token
auth.placeholder: Paste your Luckin Coffee MCP token
auth.description: The Bearer token shared by Luckin Coffee MCP and CLI. Sign in and create or copy it at https://open.lkcoffee.com/mcp. Keep this token private because it is linked to your Luckin Coffee account session.

actions.name: cancelOrder
actions.description: Cancel a Luckin Coffee order. This changes a real order and may be irreversible; confirm the exact order with the user first.

orderId.description: The exact order ID to cancel.

inputSchema.description: Input for canceling a Luckin Coffee order.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

outputSchema.description: The Luckin Coffee order cancellation result.

actions.name: createOrder
actions.description: Create a real Luckin Coffee order that may require payment. Preview the order first and obtain the user's confirmation before calling this action.

deptId.description: The Luckin Coffee store ID returned by `queryShopList`.

items.description: One configured product in an order.

inputSchema.description: Input for creating a confirmed Luckin Coffee order.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

orderId.description: The numeric order ID. Prefer `orderIdStr` when passing it to another action.

orderIdStr.description: The order ID as a lossless string.

data.description: The created Luckin Coffee order and payment details.

actions.name: previewOrder
actions.description: Preview a Luckin Coffee order, including prices and available coupons, without creating it.

deptId.description: The Luckin Coffee store ID returned by `queryShopList`.

items.description: One configured product in an order.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

aboutTime.description: The estimated pickup or delivery timestamp.

distance.description: The distance from the requested coordinates in kilometers.

items.description: One product in an order response.

productInfoList.description: The configured products in the preview.

couponCodeList.description: Coupon codes selected by the preview.

actions.name: queryOrderDetailInfo
actions.description: Get the current status, pickup details, products, payment, and delivery information for an order.

orderId.description: The lossless order ID string returned by `createOrder`.

inputSchema.description: Input for reading Luckin Coffee order details.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

orderStatus.description: Order status: 10 pending payment, 20 placed, 30 preparing, 60 ready, 80 completed, 100 canceled.

aboutTime.description: The estimated pickup or delivery timestamp.

code.description: The pickup code or its generation status.

distance.description: The distance from the requested coordinates in kilometers.

items.description: One product in an order response.

actions.name: queryProductDetailInfo
actions.description: Get the current details, attributes, SKU, and price for one Luckin Coffee product at a store.

deptId.description: The Luckin Coffee store ID returned by `queryShopList`.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

price.description: The price adjustment for this value.

anyOf.description: Whether this value can be selected.

canSelected.description: Whether this value can be selected.

data.description: A Luckin Coffee product and its current configuration.

actions.name: queryShopList
actions.description: Find nearby Luckin Coffee stores using a location and optional store name.

inputSchema.description: Input for finding Luckin Coffee stores.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

distance.description: The distance from the requested coordinates in kilometers.

actions.name: searchProductForMcp
actions.description: Search and recommend Luckin Coffee products at a specific store from the user's original request.

deptId.description: The Luckin Coffee store ID returned by `queryShopList`.

query.description: The user's original product request in natural language.

inputSchema.description: Input for searching Luckin Coffee products.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

price.description: The price adjustment for this value.

anyOf.description: Whether this value can be selected.

canSelected.description: Whether this value can be selected.

items.description: A Luckin Coffee product and its current configuration.

actions.name: switchProduct
actions.description: Change a selectable attribute on a Luckin Coffee product and return the updated SKU and price.

deptId.description: The Luckin Coffee store ID returned by `queryShopList`.

operation.description: The operation code. Use 3 to select the value.

inputSchema.description: Input for changing one product attribute.

code.description: The upstream result code. Zero indicates success.

price.description: The price adjustment for this value.

anyOf.description: Whether this value can be selected.

canSelected.description: Whether this value can be selected.

data.description: A Luckin Coffee product and its current configuration.
